mapper.select: /*selectMasterWmGrWarehousingPopDetail*/ SELECT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.BUYER)) AS COM_NAME, POHD.PO_NO AS PO_NO, MAX(PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO) AS LEGACY_PO_NO, MAX(POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE) AS PO_CREATE_DATE, MAX(PODT.RD_DATE) AS RD_DATE, IVDT.INV_NO AS INV_NO, MAX(DECODE(PODT.ITEM_QTY,IVDT.INV_QTY,'입고예정','분할입고예정')) AS STATUS, MAX(DECODE(#{HUB_YN},'Y','간선',DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','X','Kepmro','일반'))) AS DOC_TEXT, MAX(IVDT.WMS_GR_DATE) AS GR_DATE_RE, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT)) AS AGENT_NAME, MAX((SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT)) AS AGENT_TEL_NO, MAX(PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME) AS ADD_USER_NAME, MAX(PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL) AS ADD_USER_TEL, MAX(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, MAX(POHD.PO_REMARK) AS PO_REMARK, MAX(POHD.DOC_TYPE) AS DOC_TYPE, MAX(POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT, POHD.BUYER AS BUYER, MAX(NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0)) AS WMS_GR_QTY, MAX(NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0)) AS WMS_IVK_QTY, MAX((SELECT MAX(NVL(HUB_GR_QTY,0)) FROM HUBIVDT WHERE BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND S_INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND STATUS != 'D')) AS HUB_GR_QTY, MAX((SELECT MAX(NVL(HUB_IV_QTY,0)) FROM HUBIVDT WHERE BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND S_INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND STATUS != 'D')) AS HUB_IV_QTY, MAX(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE, MAX(PODT.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_CODE, MAX((SELECT ITEM_NO FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER = PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND CONTRACT_NO = PODT.CONTRACT_NO AND CONTRACT_SEQ = PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO)) AS CQDT_ITEM_NO FROM ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE POHD.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND POHD.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND IVDT.INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ GROUP BY POHD.BUYER, POHD.PO_NO, IVDT.INV_NO

/*selectMasterWmGrWarehousingPopDetail_v2*/ SELECT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.BUYER)) AS COM_NAME, POHD.PO_NO AS PO_NO, MAX(PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO) AS LEGACY_PO_NO, MAX(POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE) AS PO_CREATE_DATE, MAX(PODT.RD_DATE) AS RD_DATE, IVDT.INV_NO AS INV_NO, MAX(DECODE(PODT.ITEM_QTY,IVDT.INV_QTY,'입고예정','분할입고예정')) AS STATUS, MAX(DECODE(#{HUB_YN},'Y','간선',DECODE(POHD.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','X','Kepmro','일반'))) AS DOC_TEXT, MAX(IVDT.WMS_GR_DATE) AS GR_DATE_RE, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT)) AS AGENT_NAME, MAX((SELECT TEL_NO FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT)) AS AGENT_TEL_NO, MAX(PRDT.ADD_USER_NAME) AS ADD_USER_NAME, MAX(PRDT.ADD_USER_TEL) AS ADD_USER_TEL, MAX(POHD.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, MAX(POHD.PO_REMARK) AS PO_REMARK, MAX(POHD.DOC_TYPE) AS DOC_TYPE, MAX(POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT, POHD.BUYER AS BUYER, MAX(NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0)) AS WMS_GR_QTY, MAX(NVL(IVDT.WMS_IVK_QTY,0)) AS WMS_IVK_QTY, MAX((SELECT MAX(NVL(HUB_GR_QTY,0)) FROM HUBIVDT WHERE BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND S_INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND STATUS != 'D')) AS HUB_GR_QTY, MAX((SELECT MAX(NVL(HUB_IV_QTY,0)) FROM HUBIVDT WHERE BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND S_INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND STATUS != 'D')) AS HUB_IV_QTY, MAX(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE, MAX(NVL(IVDT.AP_BILL_FLAG,'N')) AS AP_BILL_FLAG FROM ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE POHD.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND POHD.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND IVDT.INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ GROUP BY POHD.BUYER, POHD.PO_NO, IVDT.INV_NO

/*selectMasterWmGrWarehousingPopList*/ SELECT PODT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS STDCATLG_ID, PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.ITEM_QTY ||'('|| PODT.UNIT_MEASURE || ')' AS ITEM_QTY, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, DECODE(#{HUB_YN},'Y',(SELECT NVL(HUB_GR_QTY,0) FROM HUBIVDT WHERE BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND S_INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND S_INV_SEQ = IVDT.INV_SEQ AND STATUS != 'D'),IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY) AS GR_QTY, PODT.AGENT_PRICE AS AGENT_PRICE, IVDT.ITEM_AMT AS AGENT_ITEM_AMT, PODT.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK, PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, (SELECT SUM(DECODE(#{HUB_YN},'Y',(SELECT NVL(HUB_GR_QTY,0) FROM HUBIVDT WHERE BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND S_INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND S_INV_SEQ = IVDT.INV_SEQ AND STATUS != 'D'),NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY,0))) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D') AS WMS_GR_QTY, PODT.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, IVDT.UNIT_PRICE * PODT.UNIT_PRICE AS ITEM_AMT, PODT.BUYER AS BUYER, PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, IVDT.INV_NO AS INV_NO, IVDT.INV_SEQ AS INV_SEQ, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, (SELECT MAX(DOC_TYPE) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO) AS DOC_TYPE, SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7) AS MASTER_ITEM, DECODE((SELECT MAX(DOC_TYPE) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO), 'X',(SELECT NVL(TRIM(IMG_NO),'0') FROM ITEMMAST WHERE STDCATLG_ID = SUBSTR(PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO,1,7)),'') AS IMG_NO FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE PODT.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND PODT.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND IVDT.INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY PODT.BUYER, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ
